'''D.J. Toby''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2002 Endor Regionals]] in June 2002 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|Dark Deal Droids]], according to Keith Watabayashi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3737">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-13-gens-endor-regional-reportd3737/ gens-endor-regional-report], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 13 June 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-13-gens-endor-regional-reportd3737/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
